title.value: Mmerel on the consent given for the symbiont strain assays of 2294

description.value: The household speaker who gave consent on behalf of eleven households, on what she was told and what came back. This record is the evidentiary basis of the ruling that suspended contact with the world.

content.value:
Q. Is it possible the households misunderstood what the form covered?

A. Put that away. Eleven households did not misunderstand the same sentence in the same direction. I read it to them at the line, one household at a time, in eleven evenings, and I know what I read.

Q. What did you understand the arrangement to be?

A. That the strains would be assayed, and that what came out would come to the households before it went anywhere. Not at the same time. Before. I asked for that twice and it was agreed twice, by the same person, once with the interpreter and once without.

Q. The form does not say before.

A. The form does not say after either. It was written by somebody who had never had to explain to a household why the strain in their vent has a name in a document they have not seen.

Q. When did the households learn of the results?

A. When a supply pilot mentioned it. Two years and four months. Two of those households had moved by then, on ground that the results would have told them about.

Q. Do you want the assays withdrawn?

A. No. That is another thing your people keep offering, as though the difficulty were the knowledge. Send the results. Send them to the households. Then stop coming.

Q. That last part is not ours to decide.

A. I know. That is why I am saying it slowly and why you are writing it down.

consentNote.value: Mmerel consented on condition that the record go first to the ethics panel and to the eleven households, in that order, and that no part of it be used in a publication until both had it. She asked that the sentence about stopping be kept exactly as given.
